title: LG CNS and Chainlink Partner on Korea Digital-Asset Infrastructure
why_it_matters: The partnership links a major Korean enterprise technology provider with cross-chain and data infrastructure, potentially reducing integration friction for regulated tokenized assets without yet constituting a live market launch.
